content.title: Razorback Professional Tools - RIBCO Supply
content.text: Pittsfield: (413) 997-4010 | Clarksburg: (413) 663-3791 1 / 1 In 1936, the Razor-Back brand was launched by an employee of Union Tools who envisioned a better shovel. Today, Razor-Back is the leading brand of hand-powered landscaping tools for professionals in the United States—and a market leader worldwide. Every Razor-Back tool is the product of bold innovation and a lot of hard work by people who use them day in, day out—just like you do. Demanding jobs call for the toughest tools out there. That's why professionals have relied on Razor-Back tools for more than 80 years. Razor-Back tools are made for pros, built from the strongest materials and packed with the features you expect. What we stock: 16 Tine Level Head Rake, Forged, with Wood Handle Round Point Shovel, with Wood Handle and D-Grip Square Point Shovel, Wooden Handle #14 Western Pattern Aluminum Scoop with Wood Handle and Steel D-Grip 36 Inch Aluminum Landscape Rake, with Aluminum Handle and End Grip 16 Tine Road Rake, Forged, with Wood Handle Hercules Pattern Post Hole Digger, with Fiberglass Handles, and Cushion Grips 14 Tine Asphalt Rake, Forged, with Wood Handle Square Point Shovel, Wood Handle and D-Grip 36 Inch Aluminum Asphalt Lute Rake, with Aluminum Handle, and End Grip 15 Tine Bow Rake, Forged, Wood Handle 30 Inch Aluminum Landscape Rake, with Aluminum Handle and End Grip Round Point Shovel, Open Back with Wood Handle 14-in Drain Spade with Wood Handle and D-Grip Check out their website for more information.
